name: Cabbage and Kielbasa Skillet
dupe_evidence: Not a duplicate. Closest catalog dishes are all cabbage+sausage skillets carrying a defining starch/fruit that this one lacks: kielbasa-cabbage-potato-skillet (adds potato), sausage-cabbage-apple-skillet (adds apple + rice), and haluski-and-kielbasa-cabbage-noodles (adds egg noodles). Per the 'beef chili vs beef chili mac are different dishes' rule, this plain no-starch skillet (cabbage + kielbasa + carrots + mustard/broth pan sauce, 14g carb) is a distinct plate, and it is the only low-carb entry of the group since every catalog version's starch would exceed the 35g carb condition.
cross_protein_collision_note: HIGH ATTENTION for the decider: this dish is fully protein-swappable and the catalog's entire cabbage-sausage-skillet family lives under the TURKEY protein group (smoked-turkey-sausage proxy), not pork. Watch other lanes for a same-dish twin: a smoked-turkey-sausage or generic smoked-sausage 'cabbage and sausage skillet' (no potato/noodle/apple) would be structurally identical to this and should collapse to one. If a turkey-sausage plain-cabbage-skillet candidate appears, keep the stronger single entry.
in_run_notes: No collision with pork-sausage items already in accepted-slugs.json: italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet (peppers/onions, no cabbage) and baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage (cauliflower-mac bake) are different dishes.
flag: borderline-tight against kielbasa-cabbage-potato-skillet on the protein+method+cabbage-base axis; distinguished by dropping the potato starch and the low-carb positioning. Audit-visible.
